notes: OpenRouter decision-model measurements, read from the server-rendered model pages and the rankings page on 2026-10-06 and re-read 2026-11-26 (all rows OpenRouter-measured, same method for every model). p50 latency is the best provider over all locations: a router-inclusive hosted round trip with undeclared payload mix, window 1 week (GPT-6 Luna Decisions showed a 3-day window at the 2026-10-06 capture and 1 week at the 2026-11-26 re-read). It is the best like-for-like hosted latency source found, and it ORDERS the models differently from the launch tables: at the 2026-11-26 re-read Jev 0.13 s < Clef-flash 0.15 s < Clef 0.29 s (hosted Clef is about 2.2x slower than hosted Jev; at the 2026-10-06 capture Clef-flash 0.17 s was faster than Jev 0.21 s). Perplexity Decider V1 27B, Liquid d1 and Mercury Decide have since been removed from the router; their pages no longer state latency. Hosted Clef and Clef-flash run on Workers AI, which OpenRouter says truncates long text state to roughly the first 2K tokens. Per-endpoint latency_last_30m/throughput_last_30m fields in the API were null for every decision model. Prices and context are in the pricing and capability docs. 2026-11-26 re-read: 26 figures compared, 21 changed in place - p50 latencies (ms): luna 300->190, clef-flash 170->150, clef 510->290, tev1 350->240, solar 17300->820, span-01-lite 180->200, kev 3060->730, jev 210->130; weekly requests: luna 343958->27081321, jev 981650096->880960377, span-01-lite 12375496->3868268 (standard variant), liquid-d1 2871468->2728394 (window ended 2026-11-20, model since delisted), kev 2427299->601471, clef-flash 2383654->12286432, clef 1802210->5416441, solar 1213538->503603, tev1 994273->215037, span-01 960633->77748; luna 3-day uptime 99.99%->100.00%; solar second Upstage endpoint 19.58 s->5.20 s. Retired 5 rows: pplx-decider-v1-27b and mercury-decide latency and weekly (tombstone pages), liquid-d1 latency (tombstone page; its weekly row is kept).

claims.statement: Hosted p50 on one measurement method (OpenRouter, 2026-11-26 pages): Jev 0.13 s, Clef-flash 0.15 s, Clef 0.29 s. Hosted Clef is about 2.2x SLOWER than hosted Jev here, the opposite of the Cloudflare launch ratio; Clef-flash, 1.2x faster than Jev at the 2026-10-06 capture, is now about 1.15x slower than Jev. The Perplexity Decider V1 27B page no longer states latency (the model was removed from the router).
claims.implication: For a hosted hot path compare these like-for-like numbers, not the launch table. Re-measure from your own region with your own state size.

claims.statement: Outliers on the same page method: Kev 4B (SiliconFlow) p50 0.73 s and Solar Decide p50 0.82 s (second Upstage endpoint 5.20 s); still the slowest hosted decision routes at the 2026-11-26 re-read, though far faster than the 3.06 s and 17.30 s (second endpoint 19.58 s) of the 2026-10-06 capture.

GPT-6 Luna Decisions on OpenRouter: p50 0.19 s (1-week window; 0.30 s at a 3-day window in the 2026-10-06 capture) and 3-day uptime 100.00% on the page in the capture (the endpoints API showed uptime_last_1d 100); the rankings page shows 27,081,321 weekly requests (343,958 at the 2026-10-06 capture). JevBench independently measures 0.30 s adjusted.
